preconditions.description: The number of rows n and columns m must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of colors k must be between 1 and the minimum of 40 and the total number of cities.
The number of missions q must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= r_1 <= n and 1 <= c_1 <= m and 1 <= r_2 <= n and 1 <= c_2 <= m for r_1, c_1, r_2, c_2 in missions)
preconditions.description: All mission coordinates must be within the bounds of the grid.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum time to reach the destination city for each mission.
